## The Core Problem Addressed

Traditional agency models route client briefs through account executives, strategists, and project managers before reaching junior executioners. Communication degrades, turnaround times stretch into months, and creative quality diverges from business goals.

The FlexFlow eliminates intermediary layers. The founder directly scopes the engagement, engineers the digital assets, configures the tracking pipelines, and runs campaign iterations.

## Detailed Service Catalog

### 1. Web Design & Custom Architecture (Sprint: 4 Weeks)
- High-fidelity Figma design systems with strict component governance.
- Clean semantic HTML5, modern CSS3 with custom properties, and zero-framework performance or lightweight Framer implementations.
- Sub-second first contentful paint (FCP) and optimal Core Web Vitals (LCP < 1.8s, INP < 100ms, CLS 0).
- Fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile breakpoints with accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) focus.

### 2. AI Visibility & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO / AEO) (Sprint: 5 Days)
- Optimization for emerging conversational discovery platforms: ChatGPT Search, Perplexity AI, Claude, and Google AI Overviews.
- Dense passage citability, direct question-answer structuring, and authoritative entity recognition.
- Complete Schema.org JSON-LD multi-type graph construction connecting Organization, Founder, Products, and sameAs authorities.
- Creation and deployment of curated /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt machine manifests.

### 3. Search Engine Optimization (SEO) (Sprint: Monthly Cadence)
- Commercial intent keyword research focusing on high-converting transactional queries rather than vanity volume.
- Crawlability and indexability audit: robots.txt rules, XML sitemaps, canonical tags, and status code monitoring.
- High-authority content architecture and technical debt remediation.

### 4. Performance Marketing & Paid Acquisition (Sprint: 7-Day Launch)
- Direct-response campaign architecture across Meta (Facebook & Instagram Ads) and Google Ads.
- Aggressive creative testing matrices: headline hooks, visual angles, and copy variants.
- Automated lead triage integrating WhatsApp business APIs and CRM webhooks for sub-60-second follow-up.
- Benchmark metric achievements: Cost-Per-Lead (CPL) maintained below ₹60 for competitive regional and national campaigns.

### 5. Brand Identity & Systems (Sprint: 2–3 Weeks)
- Strategic brand positioning, typography selection, contrast-accessible color palettes, and component design tokens.
- Vector logo systems, social media kit boards, and digital asset guidelines.

### 6. Social Content Batches (Sprint: 30-Post Batch)
- 30-day production batches for founder personal branding and corporate presence.
- Visual storytelling templates, editorial graphics, and engagement architectures.

## Verified Portfolio Track Record

- Polynomial Protocol: L2 decentralized perpetuals platform. Redesigned conversion hierarchy and gasless trading messaging. Shipped live in 14 days, resulting in 4x deposit growth in 60 days and sub-90s user onboarding.
- Post Bridge: Social scheduling SaaS. Redesigned onboarding and feature demonstration, increasing free trial sign-ups 3x with a +38% rise in trial-to-paid retention.
- SuperX: X creator tool. Shipped visual redesign, doubling trial conversion rates with over 250,000 launch impressions.
- ABC Tile & Sanitaryware: B2B architectural campaign generating 268 verified dealer and contractor leads at ₹55.59 per lead on Meta Ads.
- Voyage India Travel: Direct-to-WhatsApp holiday booking campaign generating 160+ qualified holiday package inquiries at ₹14.54 per lead.
- Zara Salon & Spa: Local beauty and bridal campaign reaching 1.08M impressions at ₹2.35 CPM with 28+ direct high-ticket bookings at ₹45.00 per inquiry.
